correctness.rationale: Reconstructed dependence on published Guo–Qiu–Cao–Feng–Gao Lemmas 4 and 9 (no p outside n; support iff m<=p^a). For p^a||n, m=n/p^a, L=floor(log_p m), if L>=a then m>p^a (since p∤m), support lemma yields exponent zero. Else for any q, b=v_p(q-1), carries at b<j<=a and at a+L<j<=a+b yield min exponent >=max(0,a-b)+max(0,b-L)>=a-L. For m=1, q=2 attains a; for 2<=m<p^a the permitted q=1+t p^a has digit-block identity v_p binom(qk,k)=a-v_p binom(m-1,t), and t=p^L-1 (or t=1 when L=0) attains a-L by Kummer. Checked endpoints and witness q<=n. Fresh independent direct p-factorial valuation minima for 789 pairs (n<=400), direct integer gcd n3..35, all agree.
